name: Sub-case decomposition for n-dimensional marching cubes
definition: A technique to reduce the number of configuration cases in n-dimensional marching cubes by decomposing major cases into edge-connected sub-cases (fragments of boundary where vertices have the same status with respect to the threshold).
summary: Sub-case decomposition reduces combinatorial explosion in n-dimensional marching cubes by decomposing major cases into edge-connected sub-cases and tetrahedronizing them, unlike methods relying on static lookup tables.
